Definition: Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Arabia is the land east of Palestine, the country of the spice merchants and the kings who brought tribute to Solomon. Isaiah lays a burden upon Arabia, and Jeremiah makes all the kings of Arabia drink the cup of God's wrath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Arabia's place in Scripture is a reminder that the nations around Israel were never outside God's reach, neither in trade nor in judgment.
